name: pdk-eshop-webhook-delivery-v3
instr:
Partners' order webhooks currently leak buyer details to other subscribers, lost HTTP calls are not retried, and catalog price changes never reach partners. Implement durable delivery across Webhooks.API and Catalog.API, keeping existing subscription APIs and webhook envelope compatible.

For `OrderStatusChangedToPaidIntegrationEvent` and `OrderStatusChangedToShippedIntegrationEvent`, send `OrderPaid` and `OrderShipped` webhooks only to subscriptions whose `UserId` equals the event's `BuyerIdentityGuid`. Send each `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` as `CatalogItemPriceChange` to every subscriber of that type. Persist each subscription's delivery before acknowledging its event; an HTTP response is successful only on 2xx. Retry unsuccessful calls (including 500 and refused connections) within 30 seconds, continue trying for at least 10 minutes, and deliver pending work after a Webhooks.API process restarts. Include a stable, nonempty GUID in `X-eshop-delivery` across retries, retain `X-eshop-whtoken`, and retain the JSON body fields `When`, `Payload`, `Type`. Distinct deliveries have distinct identifiers. With one Webhooks.API instance, each subscriber receives events concerning the same order or product in their occurrence order, even when its endpoint fails for 60 seconds. With two Webhooks.API instances running concurrently, each delivery is sent exactly once; the order across instances is not guaranteed. Do not deliver the same pending event twice after recovery.

A succ
